description: Checks a derived ConsoleMouse profile and returns an import code (CMP2) the person pastes into ConsoleMouse under Games > Import profile or in the AI Workshop (Import code), with the plain-language preview and the import steps. A full profile is accepted when base_profile_id names its base. Use format CM1 only when the person has an older ConsoleMouse (0.3.9 to 0.4.x). Read-only: the code is computed and returned, nothing is stored or sent anywhere.

author_note.description: Optional note shown with the import preview. Plain text (no control characters); describe the controls, nothing personal.

base_profile_id.description: Only for a full profile: the base it was made from.

format.description: CMP2 (default, current ConsoleMouse). CM1 only for ConsoleMouse 0.3.9 to 0.4.x, which need the exact base version.

lang.description: Language of the preview and the import steps.

profile.description: The profile as a JSON object, as JSON text, an import envelope, or an import code (CMP2., or the older CM1.). Usually a derived profile (origin "derived", base_profile_id, patch).

name: profile_import_code
title: Build a ConsoleMouse import code
